title: Existing bot bound to a different app id
description: abs apply --force where the existing bot already matches the desired endpoint/SKU but is bound to a DIFFERENT app id than the supplied one. Rebinding an existing bot is destructive, so the plan is a blocking conflict: apply refuses with a typed naming-conflict error (exit 2) and performs no mutation.

json.errorMessage: Cannot apply: botService at /subscriptions/sub-contoso/resourceGroups/rg-agenthost/providers/Microsoft.BotService/botServices/agenthost-bot conflicts with the request. Existing bot is bound to app id 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222, but this request targets app id 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111. Rebinding an existing bot to a different app changes its identity and is destructive, so it is not done automatically; use a different bot name, or repoint the bot deliberately after confirming the change is intended.
json.remediation: Choose a different bot name, or supply an explicit app object id (--app-object-id) to disambiguate, then re-run preview to confirm the plan before applying.
